snippet.title: 13 things you probably didn’t know about Robert Pattinson! 👀
snippet.description:
From recording rap music under the name Big Tub and being cut from his first film, to dreaming of becoming a rapper and almost quitting acting altogether, there’s a lot more to Robert Pattinson than you might think.

He’s also got some pretty unexpected stories from his early career, including his first celebrity crush, his time in a band and why he held his Harry Potter wand like a gun! 🪄
